notes.subject: עקלקלותם
notes.rationale: עקלקלות reduplication of עקל (crooked) mimics twisting paths — lost in Sepedi 'tše di kgopameng'

notes.subject: יוליכם את פעלי האון
notes.rationale: 'lead them with the workers of iniquity' (company) vs 'lead them away to' (banishment) — KJV 'with', BSB 'banish with'

notes.subject: שלום על ישראל
notes.rationale: benediction formula 'peace upon Israel', rendered as kagiso e tla ba go Yisraele

translation: Gomme ba ba kobogago ka ditsela tša tšona tše di kgopameng, Yahwe o tla ba tliša le ⟨את⟩ bao ba šomago sebe — kgalothlo! Šhalalelo go swana le seo: kagiso e tla ba go Yisraele.

tokens.gloss: ka ditsela tša tšona tše di kgopameng
